what: Clefs de la correspondance chiffree de Francois, duc de Guise, avec quelques lettres de lui (1556); keys for Dalbeyne (f. 8), comte de La Mirandole (f. 12), Dominique Du Gabre bp of Lodeve (ff. 16, 40), Anne d'Este and others. Catalogue 194 / DECODE R2276 is pp. 1-3 of this volume (read in part). Gallica btv1b9062131g, title checked.
'Steganographie, chiffres et dechiffremens', alphabets and grilles for secret writing, 17th c., 79 ff. Gallica btv1b90619093, title checked. A manual, not a letter.

Friedmann's key collection (21 ff.) for Dodieu, Du Bellay, Dinteville, Selve, Ferrara 1528-49; points to fr. 3000, 3019, 3020, 3045, 3077, 3096, 3126 and Dupuy 265, 547. Already in the ledgers (DECODE R9467, R9481). fr. 3029 and fr. 3092 are not named in the entry.

'Recueil de chiffres diplomatiques du XVIe siecle': keys of Annebaut (Piedmont 1542), G. d'Armagnac (Rodez 1544), Fresse and Richer (Denmark 1543-46), La Croix, Lyves, Botieres, Lestrange, Dampierre, Monluc (Venice), and common keys for Portugal, the Emperor, Rome, England, Venice, Germany, Italy; 49 ff. inside a patents volume. No ciphertext. Heading as printed.
'Chiffres communs' of the prince of Monaco (Rome), Tallard (London) and Bonrepaux (The Hague), copy, 1702. Key only.

shelfmark: BnF, NAF Renaudot papers, volume after NAF 7494, f. 143
what: 'Chiffres donnes a differents ministres du Roy', copy by E. Renaudot, late 17th c. The OCR heading ('1603') is wrong and the volume number is not established. Key only.
La Boderie's cipher for his London despatches (1606-11). Relevant to the repo's laboderie1608 and jeannin1607 targets. No Gallica record found by SRU for 23026 and 23594 on 15 Nov.
'Des chiffres pour la correspondance' in the abbe Le Tellier's Italian journey papers, 1667-68; the letters themselves apparently clear. No Gallica record found by SRU.
'Vocabulaire cryptographique' (1699, Latin title 'Signorum in numeris et speciebus institutio'): a code vocabulary for military and political signals, 340 + 335 ff. A code book, no ciphertext.

'Chiffre adresse par un anonyme, au mois de juin 1781, a M. Hauy, abbe de l'Academie royale d'ecriture': a second copy or sibling of lead 1195 (BULAC MS.ARA.52 item 14, 'Texte chiffre' sent to Hauy). Check it is the same cipher and add this shelfmark to lead 1195 at merge.

'Dechiffrement de lettres adressees a Francois I par les princes d'Allemagne' in a 1275-1636 German-relations miscellany: a decipherment, so a pointer for a key hunt; the ciphered letters may sit in the same or a neighbouring volume.
